items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: His name, right name is Andrew Barnett.

ctx.x: Well, no, I was thinking about back up there in Donaldsonville. Donaldsonville, I... Because there's some people I never didn't know about. I heard about Bolegs.
Bolegs. Bolegs from St. James, Louisiana. Mm-hmm. Who was he? His name, right name is Andrew Barnett. Oh, yeah?
Ha, ha, ha, ha. I just didn't know anything about him. What did he play? Drum. Was he any good?
